prompt:
Desktop web application screen, 16:9, LIGHT theme, premium modern fintech product UI, flat design with crisp detail (not a photograph). Product: "Valuta", salaries agreed in pesos paid in USDC at the rate that was live on payday. Layout:
1) Top band on cool white (#F6F8F9): wordmark "Valuta", links "Payrolls", "New payroll", "Rate lookup", live indicator "Arc mainnet · live" with a petrol dot, petrol (#0B4F6C) "Connect wallet". Under it, a line of large confident text: "Paid at the rate that was live on payday. However late. Whoever settles." Then three live figures in monospace: "11 payslips held", "10 settled late, same rate", "0.592756 USDC paid".
2) LEFT 38%: a STATEMENT, a vertical stack of eleven compact payslip coupons registered on one baseline, each a white slip with a perforated edge. Each coupon: "No. 01" · "VALUE 15 OCT 14:00" · "R292" · "0.053897 USDC", and a small petrol rubber stamp "HELD" at its right. Coupon 01 is lifted and selected with a petrol outline. Coupons 02 to 11 are quieter. A small amber coupon at the bottom: "No. 12 · VALUE 26 OCT 14:00 · fixes in 15:59:12".
3) RIGHT 62%, the selected payslip, large, as a security document on white paper with a faint guilloché pattern:
   - Header "VALUTA PAYSLIP · No. 01 of 20 · PAYROLL 1 · MXN 1.00 PER DAY".
   - A big petrol stamp "VALUE 15 OCT 2026 · 14:00 UTC".
   - Huge monospace "0.053897 USDC", with "0.053567 at the settlement-day rate" struck through below it.
   - A "RATE HELD" embossed seal.
   - A horizontal one-line timeline inside the slip: "291 · 12:58", "292 · 13:50" ringed, "PAYDAY 14:00", "293 · 14:06", a break, "settled 25 Oct 13:59".
   - Three facts with small check marks: "Round 292 was live at payday", "Round 293 came after", "Not stale: 10 minutes old (limit 25 h)".
   - Footer "settled by 0xe5CA…aBC3, not the employer · tx 0x82ff…38b7 · Verify".
Palette: cool white, paper white, ink #0E1B26, petrol #0B4F6C, carbon blue #2E3F8F for figures, amber only for the countdown. No gradients, no glow. Crisp legible text.
